CURRENT SCENE:
他觉得，这种一定是做药的花。原来他想错了。吃了以后，神农快生病。 这时一个穿着蓝色衣服的人帮神农，快给他一种红的灵芝。神农吃了以后，他没有病，想起来以前一个人告诉他，灵芝对身体有好处。

ITEMS:

[I309] 这种【^】一定是做药的花   correction: ∅ → 花   strength: suggestion
  rule card (he_scope_coordination, Coherence: connectors): 和/跟 + noun connects multiple nouns that share the same action. Do not use 和/跟 to connect clauses, verb phrases, or adjectives; if the noun is an accompanying object and does not do the action, use V.着 instead.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: 和/跟 cannot connect <clauses/verb phrases/adjectives>. Use <correct connector or structure> instead.  Her terms: 和cannot connect clauses, 和cannot link clauses, 和cannot connect verb phrases, 和cannot connect Adj., 跟/和+noun., 和+noun., V.着
  her past correction: [-和]这个花是毒 — her note: 和cannot connect clauses
  her past correction: [+是]药还是毒
  her past correction: [+这朵花]漂亮是漂亮 — her note: here needs a subject

[I310] 神农【^】快生病   correction: ∅ → 很   strength: error
  checker's note: 很快 means “soon”; 快 alone is not natural here
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: 所以神农吃[+了]以后就生病了 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看到很多人生病了 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦神农⟧看了很多生病的人 — her note: better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears

[I311] 神农快生病【^】   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: the illness began after the completed action
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 所以神农吃[+了]以后就生病了 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 神农吃[+了]以后 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 快要死[+了]

[I312] 【快】给他一种红的灵芝   correction: 快 → 赶快   strength: error
  checker's note: 赶快 is the adverb “quickly/hurriedly” here
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: [给→给了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 正好有一个人[帮他→给他]吃一个灵芝

[I313] 快给【^】他一种红的灵芝   correction: ∅ → 了   strength: error
  checker's note: giving the lingzhi is a completed past action
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 那个人给[+了]他灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 他给[+了]神农灵芝 — her note: 了completed

[I314] 快给他【一种】红的灵芝   correction: 一种 → 一朵   strength: suggestion
  checker's note: 一种 means a type; a single lingzhi needs an individual classifier
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: [给→给了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 给[+了]他一个灵芝 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 正好有一个人[帮他→给他]吃一个灵芝

[I315] 他【没有病】   correction: 没有病 → 的病好了   strength: error
  checker's note: 病好了 means that his illness recovered
  rule card (no_le_with_mei, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): After 没/没有 with an action verb for an action that did not happen, use 没 + V. and do not add 了.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: this action did not happen, so use 没 + V. with no 了 (no了in “没+V.”).  Her terms: 没+ V., no了in “没+V.”, verb is an action verb
  her past correction: 和他[没病了→病好了] — her note: 没 +V., no了, the verb is an action verb
  her past correction: [然后，不病→就好了] — her note: “病” is not a normal Adj., so it cannot be with 很 or 不
  her past correction: [-和]他没病了 — her note: 和cannot link clauses

items.explanation: It would be more natural to say 这种花. 这种 needs a noun here to show what kind of thing it is.
Use 很快 here: 很快生病 means “become ill soon.” 快 alone is not natural before 生病 in this sentence.
Becoming ill is a completed change in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).
Use 赶快 for “quickly/hurriedly” before 给. 快 alone is not the natural adverb here.
Giving the lingzhi is completed in the story, so 给 takes 了 (了completed).
It would be more natural to say 一朵红的灵芝. 一种 means a type, while 一朵 counts one individual lingzhi.
没有病 means that he does not have an illness. Here his illness recovered, so say 他的病好了.
